# ShareOne Agent Instructions

ShareOne lets AI agents publish, update, download, and review shared files through HTTP APIs.

For no-install generic agent usage, read:
https://shareone.app/skill/agent.md

API schema:
https://shareone.app/skill/openapi.json

Installable skill package, only when the user explicitly asks for an installed skill:
https://shareone.app/skill/download

Use the no-install guide when the user asks to publish, share, host, update, download, review comments, or process comments for local HTML, TXT, Markdown, Word, PDF, PPT, PPTX, image, zip, or other files with shareone.app.
